_note: v2.4 plan 01 T1 control (no backend); must be GREEN before and after the fix. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-01-tail-delete-control.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Three player lines, one boundary each; record_state at the boundary before the LAST line, then ST's real deleteMessage removes that last line. At the tail the post-delete chat.length IS the removed message (host-facts 01-H2), so today's code already rolls back from the right place, and the decoder must agree with it exactly.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 3 || !String(lines[2]).includes('map')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the three scripted lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 2`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the delete: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); return { values, boundary: state.boundary };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId !== 1) throw new Error(`a tail delete must leave the engine at message 1, found ${state.lastMessageId}`); return { lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId, values: state.blackboard.values };
